agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the sentence quoting Laodicea, "Me?", and "I spent YEARS...". That exceeds the two-sentence limit.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The second blank, "naked," cannot be reasoned out from the earlier cards. Card 5 establishes only that Laodicea claims to be rich and need nothing; while "poor" can be inferred as an opposite, "naked" is simply unseen wording the baker must guess.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
